inlines.v: HU'MOROUSLY, adverb With a wild or grotesque combination of ideas; in a manner to excite laughter or mirth; pleasantly; jocosely. Addison describes humorously the manual exercise of ladies' fans. 1. Capriciously; whimsically; in conformity with one's humor. We resolve by halves, rashly and humorously
